shape.description: Analytic two-dimensional SDF primitive; creates a new native material/mesh instance.

rimWidth.description: Inward quadratic rim width; zero uses guarded 0.001 domain width.

edgeSoftness.description: Inside coverage width; AA adds a pixel derivative minimum.

thickness.unit: phase cycles per half rim depth
thickness.description: Depth-dependent spectral phase, a visual model not physical optical thickness.

dispersion.description: Directional normal/light contribution to spectral phase.

phase.description: Periodic phase offset; phase 0 and 1 are identical.

lightAngle.description: In-plane light direction; positive rotation is counterclockwise in bottom-origin local UV.

speed.description: Accumulated animated time; zero freezes, negative reverses, pause preserves time.

opacity.description: Local extension multiplying straight alpha; zero leaves backdrop unchanged.
